<b>Pharlid Divers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are arachnids that nestle within dark holes in the  cavern roofs and pounce on prey from above.<ref>Pharlid Diver [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Arachnid that nestles within dark holes in cavern roofs. Pounces on prey from far above."</i></ref> [[Pharlid]]s are their relatives.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pharlid Divers wait patiently on the roof of caves, usually in tight crevices. When Hornet passes below them, they lunge down while wildly slashing their claws, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} on hit. They then try to jump back to their original spot; however, they can be knocked back far enough away that they have to perch on a different section of roof.

The windup of their attacks allows for dodging or avoiding by maintaining a constant [[Swift Step|dashing]] or falling speed. There is a slight pause after they return to their perch that allows for a window to attack.  [[Cross Stitch]] is also a safe way to kill them mid-attack.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Our caves...
* Our darkness...
* To hide... To nest... To live...
* Always ours...
}}

== Location ==
Pharlid Divers can be found in the outside section of the [[Whispering Vaults]], the eastern [[Underworks]], [[Weavenest Atla]], [[Verdania]], [[Wisp Thicket]], and the [[Border Caves]] above [[the Cradle]].
